title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 2. August 2026

extraction.placeName: Denkmal für die im Nationalsozialismus ermordeten Sinti und Roma Europas
extraction.summaryEn: The police issued a general order (Allgemeinverfügung) banning assemblies and events in the government district around the Memorial to the Sinti and Roma murdered under National Socialism on 2 August 2026, the day of commemoration. The order runs from 6:00 to 23:59.
